newsitem.title: USA: CPC corn refining spinoff on schedule.
newsitem.headline: CPC corn refining spinoff on schedule.

text.p: CPC International Inc said on Monday that the spinoff of its corn refining operations should be complete by year's end, noting that the operations continued to show unfavorable pricing effects in North America.

The food company said in a statement that its corn refining operations showed earnings per share of $0.01 on net income of $600,000 for the second quarter ended June 30, down from $0.10 per share on $14.1 million for the year-ago period.
CPC also said its Best Foods and Baker divisions performed well in the second quarter, although dollar results of its European operations were held back by unfavorable exchange rates.
"We continue to have enormous confidence in our European business, which we strengthened importantly this quarter with the Starlux acquisition in Spain," said chief executive C.R. Shoemate.

Including a $155 million restructuring charge, the company recorded a net loss from continuing operations of $4.1 million, or $.04 per share, for the quarter, compared with a gain of $0.94 per share on earnings of $139.7 million for the year ago period.
